story: Zoe and Raj walk up a green hill. They see many animals like sheep, cows, and monkeys. They watch a small mouse and a cat. They look at the sea and see a plane flying north.
title: A Day in Nature
setting: A large farm near the sea with hills and trees.

characters.name: Zoe
characters.look: a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow shirt

characters.name: Raj
characters.look: a young boy with short black hair and a blue t-shirt

sentences.en: Zoe and Raj walk up a green hill.
sentences.zh: Zoe和Raj走上一座绿色的山丘。
sentences.scene_prompt: Zoe and Raj walk up a green hill.

sentences.en: The summer sun is very bright today.
sentences.zh: 今天的夏日阳光非常灿烂。

sentences.scene_prompt: A white sheep stands near a tall tree.

sentences.scene_prompt: A brown cow eats grass near the tree.

sentences.scene_prompt: A cat watches a small mouse on the ground.

sentences.en: A plane flies to the north.

sentences.en: The beautiful leaves fall from trees.
sentences.zh: 美丽的叶子从树上落下。
sentences.scene_prompt: Beautiful colorful leaves fall from the trees.
